text:
Predicates:
LoanedOutTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
Footballer(x) ::: x is a football player.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
Club(y) ::: y is a football club.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in y.
Name(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
Premises:
BornIn(Ailton, 1995) ∧ Name(Ailton, Ailton) ::: Ailton Silva was born in 1995 and is known as Ailton.
Footballer(Ailton) ::: Ailton Silva is a football player.
LoanedOutTo(Ailton, Braga) ::: Ailton was loaned out to Braga.
PlaysFor(Ailton, Nautico) ::: Ailton plays for Nautico.
Brazilian(Ailton) ::: Ailton is Brazilian.
Club(Nautico) ∧ Club(Braga) ∧ Club(Fluminense) ::: Nautico, Braga, and Fluminense are football clubs.
Conclusion:
LoanedOutTo(Ailton, y) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to a football club.
